## Evidence and citations

Scientific claims link to primary sources wherever practical. Paper analyses distinguish reported observations from calculations, interpretation, and proposed experiments. Preprints are labeled explicitly.

## Corrections

Substantive corrections are dated and described in the affected article. Minor typographic changes may be made without a correction note.

## AI-assisted artwork and editing

Cover art may be AI-generated. Scientific interpretation is edited and reviewed by the author. Material AI involvement in an article's analysis will be disclosed on that article.

## Rights and reuse
